mapper.select: /* Baim05Mapper.selectDailyUserLinkPolicyList */ SELECT '' AS chk , A.CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd , A.SITE_CD AS siteCd , A.SITE_NO AS siteNo , A.SITE_NM AS siteNm , A.USE_YN AS useYn , A.USE_YN AS oriUseYn , A.DAY_LIMIT_CNT AS dayLimitCnt , CONCAT( A.CMPNY_CD , '-' , A.SITE_CD ) AS joinCd FROM ( SELECT A.CMPNY_CD , A.SITE_CD , A.SITE_NO , A.SITE_NM , IFNULL(B.USE_YN, 'N') AS USE_YN , B.DAY_LIMIT_CNT FROM TB_SITE A LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_DAILY_USER_LINK_POLICY B ON ( A.CMPNY_CD = B.CMPNY_CD AND A.SITE_CD = B.SITE_CD ) WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND A.SITE_CD = #{siteCd} ) A

/* Baim05Mapper.selectDailyUserSlotHisList */ SELECT H.HIS_ID AS hisId , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(H.CMPNY_CD, 'SYST_VAL', H.ISSUE_CHANNEL, 'SYS014') AS issueChannelNm , DATE_FORMAT(H.OCCUPY_DTIME, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS occupyDtime , DATE_FORMAT(H.RELEASE_DTIME, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS releaseDtime , CASE WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(D.USER_NM) <= 1 THEN D.USER_NM WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(D.USER_NM) = 2 THEN CONCAT(LEFT(D.USER_NM, 1), '*') ELSE CONCAT(LEFT(D.USER_NM, 2), REPEAT('*', CHAR_LENGTH(D.USER_NM) - 2)) END AS userNmMasked , CASE WHEN D.MBL_NO_LAST4 IS NULL OR D.MBL_NO_LAST4 = '' THEN '-' ELSE CONCAT('010-****-', D.MBL_NO_LAST4) END AS mblNoMasked , H.RELEASE_USER AS releaseUser , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(H.CMPNY_CD, 'SYST_VAL', H.RELEASE_TYPE, 'SYS016') AS releaseTypeNm , H.RELEASE_REASON AS releaseReason FROM TB_DAILY_USER_SLOT_HIS H LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_DAILY_USER D ON ( H.CMPNY_CD = D.CMPNY_CD AND H.USER_ID = D.USER_ID ) WHERE H.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND H.SITE_CD = #{siteCd} AND H.SLOT_NO = #{slotNo} AND H.OCCUPY_DTIME >= STR_TO_DATE(#{cutoffYmd}, '%Y%m%d') ORDER BY H.OCCUPY_DTIME DESC
